Movement: begins as an extreme macro close-up on the polished chrome emblem, the reflections of the studio lights crawling slowly across its surface. The camera pulls back smoothly and orbits gently to the left, revealing the flawless black paintwork of the car. The camera continues to retreat, revealing the whole rear of the car. Then a hand enters frame from the right, reaches for the chrome emblem, and slowly peels it away from the paintwork. The camera pushes back in as the emblem lifts, revealing the cheap plastic badge hidden beneath. The hand raises the peeled emblem toward the lens and holds it there. Sharp distorted specular highlights on the chrome emblem. Clean inverted mirror image of the car on the polished floor. Contact shadows where the tyres meet the floor. Nothing floats.

Foley: the faint squeak of fingertips on polished chrome; the soft rustle of a sleeve.

OBJECTS: In the foreground, resting directly on the floor, a single cold naturally-aspirated V8 engine block, removed from a vehicle. Bare metal, dark, cold, faintly dusty. Dead. Behind it, a black Toyota Land Cruiser LC300 ZX, pristine, boxy, imposing, headlights illuminated. Accurate panel gaps, accurate wheel geometry, correct proportions.

SUBJECT: One professional presenter, matching the reference image exactly. Wearing a crisp white tailored business suit. Formal, composed. She stands beside the engine block, between it and the vehicle.

CAMERA: Shot on ARRI Alexa 35, ARRI Signature Prime 35mm, T5.6, Super 35. Deep focus, the engine block, the presenter and the vehicle all sharp.
Movement: begins as an extreme close-up on the V8 engine block, orbiting slowly. The camera then retreats smoothly and cranes upward, revealing the block alone in the vast white void, the presenter standing beside it, and the Land Cruiser rising into frame behind them.
Frame: 9:16 vertical. Symmetrical, centre-weighted.

PERFORMANCE:
· At 2s: the presenter is looking down at the engine block, expression still and focused.
· At 3s: she turns her head first, eyes following a beat later, up toward the lens.
· At 4s: one slow blink. She holds the lens. Arms fold, right over left, settling with weight.
· Expression returns to neutral. Nothing freezes or holds unnaturally.

ENVIRONMENT LIGHTING: Soft, bright, diffused overhead light. High-key, even, no visible fixtures. Light bounces off the polished white floor back up onto everything.
CHARACTER LIGHTING: Soft key from camera-left at 45 degrees, large source. 2:1 fill ratio. Subtle rim light separating hair and shoulder from the white background. Soft catchlight in the eyes.

COLOUR: Neutral clean grade, no colour cast. White balance 5600K cool-white. Limited palette: white, black, cold steel only. Low saturation. Lifted blacks, no crush. Natural accurate skin tone, not orange, not waxy.

REFLECTIONS: Physically accurate reflections. Clean inverted mirror image of the engine block, the presenter and the vehicle on the polished floor. Environment curving correctly across the black paintwork. Contact shadows where the engine block, her shoes and the tyres meet the floor. Nothing floats.

MOOD: Reverence, menace, inevitability.

LOOK: Kodak Vision3 500T aesthetic, fine 35mm film grain, 24fps. Natural motion blur. Photoreal skin texture with visible pores and fine flyaway hairs. Natural fabric drape. Photoreal metal texture, faint dust, cold surfaces.

Negative: cuts, jump cuts, flicker, post transitions, CGI plastic look, waxy skin, warped rims, floating object, extra wheels, melting badge, deformed hands, extra fingers, text artifacts, watermark, oversaturated HDR, cartoon, frozen expression, duplicated person.

Corporate brand film for a car dealership. ONE SINGLE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS TAKE. No cuts, no flicker, no transitions.

SETTING: A bright, spacious, modern performance-car showroom. White minimalist architecture, open volume, mirror-polished floor with clean reflections. Three cars staggered on the floor: a red Toyota Supra A80 at far left, a blue Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 in the centre, a gloss black Nissan GT-R R35 at right. Pristine bodywork, accurate panel gaps, accurate wheel geometry.

SUBJECTS: Four professional showroom staff members, matching the four reference images exactly. All wear crisp white tailored business suits. Formal, composed, corporate. Reference image 1 = Staff 1. Reference image 2 = Staff 2. Reference image 3 = Staff 3 (centre position). Reference image 4 = Staff 4.

CAMERA CHOREOGRAPHY:
0-1s: Medium-close shot, camera orbits smoothly and horizontally. Staff 1 centred in frame, head lowered, focused expression.
1-3s: Staff 2 walks through the extreme foreground of the lens, creating a natural defocused foreground wipe. Focus racks back to Staff 3 standing behind. Staff 3 turns to face the lens.
3-8s: Camera retreats smoothly and arcs left. Staff 3 holds the camera's gaze and folds their arms. The blue R34 enters frame behind them. Staff 4 becomes clearly visible behind and to the side of Staff 3, arms folded, steady stance.
8-15s: Camera continues retreating and panning left, settling into a wide symmetrical group frame. All four staff members clearly visible and countable at once: Staff 2 standing beside the red Supra on the left, Staff 1 standing on the right, Staff 3 centred in front of the blue R34, Staff 4 behind-left of Staff 3 but fully visible, not blocked by any car body or any other person. A formal four-person corporate team tableau arranged around the centre car.

AUDIO: Rhythmic, driving, premium commercial music bed. Faint air movement during the camera move, crisp footsteps on the polished floor, subtle fabric rustle. No voiceover, no dialogue.

LOOK: 35mm film grain, Kodak Vision3 500T aesthetic. Soft, bright, cool-white lighting. Clean colour, natural light-to-shadow transitions, accurate floor reflections. Mood: professionalism, competence, team strength.

CONSTRAINTS: Exactly four staff members visible. Not three. Not five. All four fully visible in the final wide frame. All in white suits. No dark suits. Do not merge, duplicate or omit anyone.
